items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: I played with him with Paul Bobbler.

ctx.x: I don't have much work for it.

I was with Cotter when he first started out. They had a recording couple come down here and record it. He wanted him. Well, I was playing guitar then. I got the album riding in some way. Well, we'd been high, you know, just a long time. I played with him with Paul Bobbler. When he had the Dixie Land Hall on Boyle Street, I know you can remember that. He was with that. And, and he was with the band, with the Puyon band, like I told you. and he was playing songs there, I played the wrong time, but it all come back…
